text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Transcend-chan.
Did you gather the info I asked for the other day?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Totes. Here's the report.
Could you check it over for me?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? This isn't
what I asked for, though...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Did I maybe
misunderstand what you wanted me to do...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Nwaaa~~, my bad!
Sorry, I'll recover right away!
